description: This is a PHP source file defining the WelcomeController class within the OrangeHRM Installer Controller namespace. The class extends an abstract class and contains a method preRender that sets up a Vue.js component for a welcome screen, including a product version property.

classes.name: WelcomeController
classes.description: Controller for handling the welcome page in the installer process, responsible for setting up the Vue.js welcome component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the welcome-screen component with product version property and updates the current installation step.
